rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The account of Jesus and his mother given here is the true account, unlike the Christians’ fabrications.
rows.anchor: دون ما عداه من أكاذيب النصارى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wording with the partitive min emphatically denies every deity besides Allah, rebutting Christian trinitarianism.
rows.anchor: صرح فيه بمن الاستغراقية تأكيدا للرد على النصارى في تثليثهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Allah is irresistible in power and encompasses all knowledge; no one shares either attribute in a way that would make them divine.
rows.anchor: لا أحد يشاركه في القدرة والحكمة ليشاركه في الألوهية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they turn away from the proofs, stop debating and entrust them to Allah, who knows their corrupt aims and can requite them.
rows.anchor: فاقطع كلامك عنهم وفوض أمرهم إلى الله فإن الله عليم بفساد المفسدين

rows.speaker: القاشاني
rows.claim: The prophets’ challenge of mutual imprecation has great effect because their souls connect to the Holy Spirit and God supports them through it.
rows.anchor: واعلم أن لمباهلة الأنبياء تأثيرا عظيما سببه اتصال نفوسهم بروح القدس

rows.speaker: القاشاني
rows.claim: The Christians’ souls were affected by the Prophet’s presence and fear, so they held back from the challenge and sought a truce through the jizya.
rows.anchor: كيف انفعلت نفوس النصارى من نفسه عليه السلام قبل المباهلة بالخوف وأحجمت عن المباهلة فطلبت الموادعة بالجزية؟ كذا في "التأويلات القاشانية"

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A saint’s supplication against someone can likewise bring illness, death, or other calamities.
rows.anchor: وكذا حال الولي إذا دعا على إنسان يكون له تأثير بالمرض أو الموت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The poet al-Basati addressed Sheikh Kamal al-Din al-Khujandi rudely; the sheikh answered immediately, but the anecdote breaks off before the poet’s reply.
rows.anchor: روي أن الشاعر البساطي رأى يوما الشيخ كمال الدين الخجندي في مجلس الشعراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the Prophet longed for their faith, God directs him from disputation to an impartial, fair invitation that sound reason can accept.
rows.anchor: كان عليه السلام حريصا على إيمانهم فأمره الله تعالى بأن يعدل عن طريق المجادلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taʿālaw means attend to the proposed matter and examine it, not physically move; the word began with rising from a low place to a high one.
rows.anchor: والمراد تعيين ما دعوا إليه والتوجه إلى النظر فيه وإن لم يكن انتقالا من مكان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The shared word is one on which messengers and scriptures agree, with fairness between the parties and no bias toward either.
rows.anchor: لا يختلف فيها الرسل والكتب فيها إنصاف من بعضنا لبعض ولا ميل فيها لأحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshipping Allah alone means affirming his oneness in worship and devoting worship sincerely to him.
rows.anchor: أي : نوحده بالعبادة ونخلص فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shirk means granting another a share in the right to worship or considering another worthy of worship.
rows.anchor: ولا نجعل غيره شريكا في استحقاق العبادة ولا نراه أهلا لأن نعبده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taking one another as lords includes calling Ezra or Christ God’s son and obeying rabbis’ invented permissions and prohibitions, although they are fellow humans.
rows.anchor: بأن نقول عزير ابن الله والمسيح ابن الله ولا نطيع الأحبار فيما أحدثوا

rows.speaker: الفضيل
rows.claim: Al-Fudayl says he does not care whether someone obeys a creature while disobeying the Creator or prays away from the qibla.
rows.anchor: وعن الفضيل لا أبالي أطعت مخلوقا في معصية الخالق أم صليت لغير القبلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they refuse tawhid and reject associating partners with God, tell them the proof has been established and acknowledge that the Muslims have submitted.
rows.anchor: لزمتكم الحجة فاعترفوا بأنا مسلمون دونكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet’s letter to Caesar invites him to Islam, promising safety from worldly captivity and the afterlife’s punishment, doubled reward, and responsibility for the Arisiyyin if he refuses.
rows.anchor: روي أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كتب إلى قيصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Heraclius recognized the Prophet’s signs from the old scriptures and said he would kiss his feet if he met him, but feared losing his kingship.
rows.anchor: وعرفها ممن جاء بكتابه فقال : لو كنت عنده لقبلت قدميه

rows.speaker: هرقل
rows.claim: Heraclius wrote that he acknowledged Muhammad as a prophet but could not leave the old religion God had chosen for Jesus.
rows.anchor: إنا نشهد أنك نبي ولكنا لا نستطيع أن نترك الدين القديم

rows.speaker: النبي عليه السلام
rows.claim: The Prophet said Heraclius’s kingdom would endure until the Day of Resurrection.
rows.anchor: فعجب النبي عليه السلام فقال : "لقد ثبت ملكهم إلى يوم القيامة أبدا"

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: Khosrow tore up the Prophet’s letter and the envoy returned after Khosrow tried to kill him; the Prophet prayed that their rule be torn apart, and it was.
rows.anchor: فدعا عليه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال : "خرق الله ملكهم فلا ملك لهم أبدا"

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inward lesson is that every religion rests on sincere servitude: as one worships only Allah, one seeks no other besides him.
rows.anchor: أصول الأديان كلها إخلاص العبودية كما قال تعالى :

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inward prohibition against making people lords rejects seeking provision through them and seeing worldly events as mediated by them.
rows.anchor: في طلب الرزق ورؤية الأمور من الوسائط {فإن تولوا}

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who turn away are to be told that Muslims surrender to God in tawhid, sincere worship, and the denial of shirk.
rows.anchor: مستسلمون لما دعانا الله إليه من التوحيد والإخلاص في العبودية ونفى الشرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The demand for testimony is so disbelievers will testify to Muslims’ monotheism at the Resurrection, making their testimony evidence against themselves.
rows.anchor: والسر في الإشهاد على الإسلام ليشهد الكفار لهم يوم القيامة على الإسلام والتوحيد

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: The Prophet told Abu Saʿid that every jinn, human, or other being within an adhan’s range will testify for the caller on the Day of Resurrection.
rows.anchor: كما قال النبي عليه السلام لأبي سعيد الخدري رضي الله عنه : "إني أراك تحب الغنم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tawhid is the firmest handhold and root of all roots; sincere adherence receives acceptance from the unseen.
rows.anchor: فالتوحيد هي العروة الوثقى وأصل الأصول يهب من جانب الغيب لمن أخلصه قبول القبول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One should study the Quran’s meanings instead of turning away, pursue knowledge and deeds, and avoid ignorance and error before death.
rows.anchor: فعلى العاقل أن لا يخالف كتاب الله بالإعراض عن فحاويه وعدم التدبر في معانيه

rows.speaker: الحكيم الرومي
rows.claim: At Anushirwan’s court, the Byzantine sage named old age combined with poverty as life’s greatest hardship.
rows.anchor: فقال الحكيم الرومي : هو الشيخوخة مع الفقر

rows.speaker: الحكيم الهندي
rows.claim: The Indian sage named illness and bodily pain combined with many sorrows and worries as the greatest hardship.
rows.anchor: وقال الحكيم الهندي : المرض وعلة البدن مع كثرة الغموم والهموم

rows.speaker: الحكيم بزرجمهر
rows.claim: Bozorgmehr said the greatest hardship is approaching death with bad deeds, and the other sages agreed with him.
rows.anchor: وقال الحكيم بزرجمهر : هو قرب الأجل وسوء العمل فاتفقوا على قوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jews and Christians each claimed Abraham belonged to their religion and brought the dispute to the Prophet; Bursevi reads the verse as rejecting those claims.
rows.anchor: تنازعت اليهود والنصارى في إبراهيم عليه السلام وزعم كل واحد منهما أنه عليه السلام منهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their claim is impossible because Abraham died before the Torah and Gospel and before the later names of Judaism and Christianity arose.
rows.anchor: وأنتم سميتم باليهودية والنصرانية بعد نزول الكتاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The chronology reinforces the point: Moses came a thousand years after Abraham, and Jesus two thousand years after Moses.
rows.anchor: بين إبراهيم وموسى ألف سنة وبين موسى وعيسى ألفي سنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Many contemporary shaykhs claim states they have not attained and mislead people with false tales devoid of meaning and reality.
rows.anchor: وجدت أكثرهم مدعين ما لم يتحققوا به يضلون الناس بأكاذيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The discerning should not be deceived by their appearance or imitate them, but distinguish truth from falsehood and the learned from the ignorant.
rows.anchor: فعلى العاقل أن لا يغتر بظاهرهم ولا يخرج عن المنهاج مقتفيا بآثارهم

rows.speaker: نصارى نجران
rows.claim: The Christians of Najran alleged that Jesus told them to take him as a lord; Bursevi rejects the allegation.
rows.anchor: حيث قال نصارى نجران إن عيسى عليه السلام أمرنا أن نتخذه ربا حاشاه عليه السلام

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: When a Muslim asked whether they should prostrate to the Prophet as they greeted one another, he said God forbid worshipping or commanding worship of anyone besides God.
rows.anchor: يا رسول الله نسلم عليك كما يسلم بعضنا على بعض أفلا نسجد لك فقال : "معاذ الله أن نعبد غير الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wording “for a human” signals the reason for the ruling: being human is incompatible with the alleged command to worship him.
rows.anchor: فإن البشرية منافية للأمر الذي أسنده الكفرة إليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The revealed book speaks truth, commands tawhid, and forbids shirk; examples include the Torah, Gospel, and Quran.
rows.anchor: الناطق بالحق الآمر بالتوحيد الناهي عن الإشراك كالتوراة والإنجيل والقرآن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hukm means understanding and knowledge, including wisdom as perfected knowledge and action; scholars of language and exegesis agree it means knowledge.
rows.anchor: وإيتاء الكتاب يستلزم إيتاء الحكم وهو الحكمة المعبر عنها باتقان العلم والعمل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sequence is book revelation, the prophet’s grasp of its meaning and secrets, then his communication of that understanding to people as prophethood.
rows.anchor: فالكتاب السماوي ينزل أولا ثم إنه يحصل في عقل النبي فهم ذلك الكتاب وأسراره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In “servants of me,” min attaches to ʿibādan because that word carries the sense of an action.
rows.anchor: من متعلق بلفظ عبادا لما فيه من معنى الفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A non-emphatic nisba to a beard is called lahwi; the source contrasts this with the intensive rabbani form.
rows.anchor: وإذا نسب إلى اللحية من غير قصد المبالغة يقال لحوي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A rabbani is complete in knowledge and action and firmly adheres to obedience, God’s religion, and knowledge of God.
rows.anchor: فالرباني هو الكامل في العلم والعمل الشديد التمسك بطاعة الله تعالى ودينه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to become rabbani is grounded in persistent teaching and studying the book; teaching is mentioned first because it is more honorable.
rows.anchor: بسبب مثابرتكم على تعليم الكتاب ودراسته أي قراءته وتقديم التعليم على الدراسة لزيادة شرفه عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The accusative clause about taking angels and prophets as lords attaches to “then he says”; the extra negation reinforces the earlier denial.
rows.anchor: بالنصب عطف على ثم يقول ولا مزيدة لتأكيد معنى النفي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse also rejects beliefs that angels are God’s daughters or that Ezra and Christ are God’s sons.
rows.anchor: كما قال قريش والصابئون الملائكة بنات الله واليهود والنصارى عزير ابن الله والمسيح ابن الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rhetorical question denies that a prophet would command disbelief after people had submitted; doing so would strip him of prophethood and faith.
rows.anchor: فإنه لو أمركم بذلك لكفر ونزع منه النبوة والإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gives revelation only to pure souls, so prophethood cannot coexist with calling people to worship another besides God.
rows.anchor: فإنه تعالى لا يؤتى الوحي والكتاب إلا نفوسا طاهرة وأوراحا طيبة فلا يجمع بشر بين النبوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Knowledge and study are meant to produce firm obedience; learning without action is like a beautiful tree that bears no useful fruit.
rows.anchor: فكان مثل من غرس شجرة حسناء تؤنقه أي تعجبه بمنظرها ولا تنفعه بثمرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Neither action without knowledge nor knowledge without action establishes a relationship with God; the scholar who does not act is as disconnected as an ignorant worker.
rows.anchor: فعلم أن العالم الذي لا يعمل بعلمه منقطع النسبة بينه وبين ربه كالعامل الجاهل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kaʾayyin is formed by adding kāf to ayy, giving it the meaning of the many in the rhetorical question kam khabariyya.
rows.anchor: أصله : أي دخلت الكاف عليها فحدث فيها معنى التكثير فهي بمعنى كم الخبرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The tamyiz “prophet” normally takes min and is genitive, but the source says genitive is impossible here because its final tanwin cannot remain in an annexation.
rows.anchor: وجره ممتنع لأن آخره تنوين وهو لا يثبت مع الإضافة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clause about many prophets is the predicate of kaʾayyin, which is the subject; the verb is assigned to its overt subject.
rows.anchor: خبر لقوله : كأين لأنها مبتدأ والفعل مسند إلى ظاهره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One derivation relates ribbiyyun to Rabb, like rabbani, with the kasra arising from changes Arabs make in relational forms.
rows.anchor: والربى منسوب إلى الرب كالرباني وكسر الراء من تغييرات النسب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another derivation relates ribbiyyun to ribba, meaning a group.
rows.anchor: أو منسوب إلى الربة وهي الجماعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse means many prophets fought with many pious scholars or large groups to exalt God’s word and religion.
rows.anchor: والمعنى كثير من الأنبياء قاتل معه لاعلاء كلمة الله وإعزاز دينه علماء أتقياء أو جماعات كثيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse’s test of wealth includes the lesser jihad: whether people fight and spend their property in God’s path.
rows.anchor: بالجهاد الأصغر هل تجاهدون بها وتنفقونها في سبيل الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The greater jihad tests whether people put others first despite their own need and struggle in God with their whole selves.
rows.anchor: وأما الأنفس فهل تجاهدون في الله حق جهاده أو لا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those from whom believers hear harm are outward scholars among the People of the Book and ostentatious readers or ascetics among the polytheists; the harm includes slander, blame, denial, and objection.
rows.anchor: يعني أهل العلم الظاهر {ومن الذين أشركوا} أي أهل الرياء من القراء والزهاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Patience means enduring self-struggle, spending wealth, and people’s abuse; taqwa is turning from everything besides God, a matter of firm resolve.
rows.anchor: على جهاد النفس وبذل المال وأذية الخلق {وتتقوا} بالله عما سواه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This resolve is the kind required of the resolute messengers, as the Quran says to be patient as they were.
rows.anchor: كما قال {فاصبر كما صبر أولوا العزم من الرسل} (الأحقاف : 35)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Without God’s guidance, a person cannot reach noble character, good qualities, or elevated states.
rows.anchor: فظهر أن من لم يهد الله لا يهتدي إلى مكارم الأخلاق وحسان الخصال وسنيات الأحوال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The covenant was taken from Jewish and Christian scholars through the prophets.
rows.anchor: وهم علماء اليهود والنصارى وذلك أخذ على لسان الأنبياء عليهم السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They were required to reveal the whole book’s rulings and reports to people, especially its news of the Prophet’s prophethood.
rows.anchor: وتظهرن جميع ما فيه من الأحكام والأخبار التي من جملتها أمر نبوته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The emphatic command answers an oath implied by the covenant-taking; the pronoun refers to the book.
rows.anchor: والضمير للكتاب وهو جواب قسم ينبىء عنه أخذ الميثاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The coordinated prohibition is not emphatic with nun because it is negative.
rows.anchor: عطف على الجواب وإنما لم يؤكذ بالنون لكونه منفيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nabadh means to cast away or put at a distance; the scholars threw down the covenant they had accepted.
rows.anchor: النبذ الرمي والإبعاد أي طرحوا ما أخذ منهم من الميثاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Putting something behind one’s back figures total disregard, while placing it before one’s eyes signals full care.
rows.anchor: مثل في الاستهانة به والإعراض عنه بالكلية كما أن جعله نصب العين علم في كمال العناية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Buying the small price is a metaphor for exchanging the duty to disclose scripture for worldly goods.
rows.anchor: بالكتاب الذي أمروا ببيانه ونهوا عن كتمانه والاشتراء مستعار لاستبدال متاع الدنيا بما كتموا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They feared belief would end their benefits, so they hid what they knew about the Prophet and told their followers to deny him.
rows.anchor: فلما كرهوا أن يؤمنوا فينقطع ذلك عنهم كتموا ما علموا من ذلك وأمروهم أن يكذبوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the phrase bʾisa ma yashtarun, ma is an indefinite accusative explaining the subject of bʾisa, yashtarun is its adjective, and the dispraised exchange is omitted.
rows.anchor: ما نكرة منصوبة مفسرة لفاعل بئس ويشترون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although the immediate case is Jews and Christians concealing truth for worldly gain, the warning also covers Muslims who conceal Quranic rulings.
rows.anchor: إلا أن حكمهما يعم من كتم من المسلمين أحكام القرآن الذي هو أشرف الكتب

rows.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
rows.claim: Al-Kashshaf takes the verse as proof that scholars must disclose everything they know and not conceal truth for a corrupt purpose.
rows.anchor: قال صاحب الكشاف وكفى به دليلا على أنه مأخوذ على العلماء أن يبينوا الحق للناس

rows.speaker: صاحب الكشاف
rows.claim: He lists appeasing oppressors, winning their favor, gaining unsupported worldly benefit, and jealousy over credit as corrupt motives for concealment.
rows.anchor: وتطييب لنفوسهم واستجلاب لمسارهم أو لجر منفعة من حطام الدنيا

rows.speaker: الإمام
rows.claim: The cited Tafsir al-Imam says anyone who fails to explain truth or conceals any of it falls under the verse’s threat.
rows.anchor: فكل من لم يبين الحق للناس وكتم شيئا من هذه الأمور دخل تحت وعيد الآية كذا في "تفسير الإمام"

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One should keep intentions sound both inwardly and outwardly and cleanse the heart of turning away, wrongdoing, and denial.
rows.anchor: فعلى المرء أن يحسن نيته حال الإضمار والإظهار ويطهر سريرته من لوث الإعراض والأوزار والإنكار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The concluding verse urges people not to trade knowledge and Quran for their desires or fear people when openly stating the rulings commanded by God.
rows.anchor: يعني لا تشتر بالعلم والقرآن ما تربي به نفسك من شهواتك ولا تخف من الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In an anecdote, a sage declines a share of Dhul-Qarnayn’s kingdom because people resent wealth and power but love the contented.
rows.anchor: لأن الناس أعداؤك بسبب المال والمملكة وجميعهم أحبابي بسبب القناعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who rejoice are celebrating their deceit and concealment of truth.
rows.anchor: بما فعلوا من التدليس وكتمان الحق.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They want praise for keeping the covenant, revealing truth, and speaking honestly, although they did none of those things.
rows.anchor: من الوفاء بالميثاق وإظهار الحق والإخبار بالصدق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The repeated prohibition intensifies the first; mafaza means deliverance from punishment, which they will not attain.
rows.anchor: {فلا تحسبنهم} تأكيد لقوله لا تحسبن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their painful punishment is for disbelief and deception.
rows.anchor: {ولهم عذاب أليم} بكفرهم وتدليسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Allah alone owns the heavens and earth and everything in them, with authority over creation, destruction, life, death, punishment, and reward.
rows.anchor: بحيث يتصرف فيهما وفيما فيهما كيف يشاء ويريد إيجادا وإعداما إحياء وإماتة تعذيبا وإثابة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The guilty remain within Allah’s power, cannot escape his punishment, and may be seized whenever he wills.
rows.anchor: لا يخرجون عن قبضة قدرته ولا ينجون من عذابه يأخذهم متى شاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reported occasion is that Jews contradicted what the Torah said when the Prophet asked them, then acted as though they had told the truth and rejoiced in their deception.
rows.anchor: روي أنه عليه السلام سأل اليهود عن شيء مما في التوراة فأخبروه بخلاف ما كان فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation identifies all hypocrites, who rejoiced at displaying faith and sought Muslim praise despite inward disbelief and enmity.
rows.anchor: وقيل : هم المنافقون كافة وهو الأنسب بظاهر قوله تعالى :

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bursevi prefers applying the passage generally to anyone who boasts of a good deed and seeks praise for virtues and piety they lack; a specific occasion does not restrict the rule.
rows.anchor: والأولى إجراء الموصول على عمومه شاملا لكل من يأتي بشيء من الحسنات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The source gives the surah’s verse count as either 175 or 177.
rows.anchor: وهي مائة وخمس اوست أو سبع وسبعون آية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The address includes those present when it was revealed and later people, but not earlier generations, who were not bound by this law.
rows.anchor: خطاب عام يتناول الموجودين في زمان الخطاب ومن بعدهم دون المنقرضين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exclusion of earlier people follows because they were not obligated by the Prophet’s law; including all Adam’s descendants would imply an impossible retroactive duty.
rows.anchor: بدليل أنهم ما كانوا متعبدين بشرعنا فلو كان عاما لجميع بني آدم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taqwa here means preserving mutual rights and duties of connection instead of neglecting or severing them.
rows.anchor: في حفظ ما بينكم من الحقوق وما يجب وصله ومراعاته ولا تضيعوه ولا تقطعوا ما أمرتم بوصله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Creator formed people through successive stages and with differing forms and colors.
rows.anchor: أي قدر خلقكم حالا بعد حال على اختلاف صوركم وألوانكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The single soul is their one origin, Adam, and recalling the favor of creation turns people toward fearing their Creator.
rows.anchor: من أصل واحد وهو نفس آدم أبيكم وعقب الاتقاء بمنة الخلق كيلا يتقي إلا الخالق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spouse created from the single soul is their mother Eve, made from part of Adam, from his left rib.
rows.anchor: يعني من بعضها {زوجها} أمكم حواء بالمد من ضلع من أضلاعه اليسرى.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says God put Adam to sleep in the Garden and created Eve from him while he was between sleep and waking; on waking, he felt drawn to her because she was part of him.
rows.anchor: روي أن الله تعالى لما خلق آدم عليه السلام وأسكنه الجنة ألقى عليه النوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eve is mentioned after Adam although created first because the conjunction waw does not itself establish sequence.
rows.anchor: وأخرت حواء في الذكر وإن كانت مقدمة في الخلق لأن الواو لا ترتيب فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humanity spread from Adam and Eve through procreation, producing many men and women.
rows.anchor: من تلك النفس وزوجها المخلوقة بطريق التوالد والتناسل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The masculine plural for men reflects collective number; the text says men are numerous, while the source says wisdom implies women are even more numerous.
rows.anchor: واكتفى بوصف الرجال بالكثرة عن وصف النساء بها إذ الحكمة تقتضي أن يكون أكثر.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The shared origin prepares the command to preserve household and social rights, since people branch from one root and should not compete destructively.
rows.anchor: لأن المراد به تمهيد للأمر بالتقوى فيما يتصل بحقوق أهل منزله وبني جنسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling on one another by God and by kinship reflects the Arab custom of invoking the womb ties to awaken compassion.
rows.anchor: وجرت عادة العرب على أن أحدهم إذا استعطف غيره يقرن الرحم في السؤال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-arham may be parsed in the accusative as coordinated with the case of the preceding prepositional phrase or with Allah; either way, the command is to maintain kinship and not sever it.
rows.anchor: فقوله والأرحام بالنصب عطف على محل الجار والمجرور كقولك مررت بزيد وعمرا أو على الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mentioning kinship beside God signals its importance and closeness to him.
rows.anchor: وقد نبه سبحانه إذ قرن الأرحام باسمه على أن صلتها بمكان منه وعنه صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: The Prophet reports that kinship hangs from the Throne and says God connects with whoever maintains it and cuts off whoever severs it.
rows.anchor: وعنه صلى الله عليه وسلم "الرحم معلقة بالعرش تقول : من وصلني وصله الله ومن قطعني قطعه الله"

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: The Prophet says maintaining kinship is a good deed whose reward comes quickly, while injustice is a sin whose punishment comes quickly.
rows.anchor: وقال صلى الله عليه وسلم "ما من عمل حسنة أسرع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People should honor mutual rights because all are siblings through Adam and Eve, especially believers, who also share kinship through faith and religion.
rows.anchor: لأن الكل أخ لأب وأم هما آدم وحواء سيما المؤمنين لأن فيهم قرابة الإيمان والدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-raqib means the watcher who preserves every deed, observes speech and inward intentions, and intends to recompense people for them.
rows.anchor: الرقيب هو المراقب الذي يحفظ عليك جميع أفعالك أي حافظا مطلعا على جميع ما يصدر عنكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because God knows what is hidden and more hidden, a person must act with caution and fear in all that they do.
rows.anchor: فبين الله تعالى أنه يعلم السر وأخفى إذا كان كذلك فيجب أن يكون المرء حذرا خائفا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taqwa is the foundation and the means to the greatest honor in this world and the next.
rows.anchor: واعلم أن التقوى هي العمدة وهي سبب الكرامة العظمى في الدنيا والعقبى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A man in Basra became known for a musk scent after resisting a woman’s sexual advances by soiling himself; in a dream Gabriel rubbed him, and the fragrance remained as a blessing of taqwa.
rows.anchor: فقلت : الله الله فقالت : لا بأس فقلت : إني حازق فدخلت الخلاء وتغوطت ومسحت به وجهي وبدني
